title: Add installer first-run provisioning

context.summary: Provision the first project and bearer token after installer Compose startup succeeds.
context.background: TASK-66 starts the stack through health checks but intentionally stops before initial credentials. This task closes the first-run loop by generating credentials, seeding them and saving them under MINDORY_HOME/config.

in: Generate first-run project/token identifiers and raw bearer token.
Add a provisioning script that creates the project and token in PostgreSQL.
Run provisioning through the API Compose service after health checks.
Write generated credentials to MINDORY_HOME/config/initial-token.json with restrictive permissions.
Rollback the generated credentials file on provisioning failure.
Update CLI output and docs with next steps.

acceptance_criteria: Installer execution can run all plan steps through create-first-token.
First-run credentials are generated when not supplied by tests.
Provisioning command receives project id, token id, raw token and public API URL.
initial-token.json is written under MINDORY_HOME/config and redacts nowhere because it is the one-time credential output.
CLI start reports provisioning complete and no pending steps.
pnpm check validates provisioning with fake Compose command runners.

manual_checks: Confirm no real secrets are committed.

risks: Raw first-run token must be written only to generated MINDORY_HOME, never repo files.
Provisioning should not depend on a pre-existing API token.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
